change.defect: Relative NtCreateFile accepted trailing-dot names, trailing-space names, and reserved device names. A closed directory handle was not rejected until the native call failed. New objects were not checked for the parent volume.
change.correction: Reject those names before NtCreateFile. Reject a closed handle before use. Require the new object's volume serial to match the parent handle and reject a reparse attribute on a new file.
change.not_claimed: This does not make the initial CreateFileW pathname open trustworthy.
